nodes.label: Official Tooling Only Policy
nodes.rationale: Official documented setup paths prevent unsupported hand-rolled alternatives and monorepo drift.

nodes.label: SEC-7 Marketing Source Protection
nodes.rationale: Classic Git exposes the monorepo under public_html unless .htaccess denies source trees and sensitive files.

nodes.label: Radix UI to Base UI Migration
nodes.norm_label: radix ui to base ui migration

nodes.label: Golden Pair Migration Strategy
nodes.rationale: CLI-delivered golden pairs preserve exact registry variants and reduce guesswork compared with reconstructing transforms.

nodes.label: Branch-First Development Flow
nodes.rationale: One isolated Neon branch per feature prevents shared-state leakage and mirrors Git workflows.

nodes.label: Runtime-Aware Postgres Driver Selection
nodes.rationale: Long-running runtimes can reuse a pg pool, while isolated serverless runtimes need an HTTP-oriented serverless driver.

nodes.label: shadcn Component Composition
nodes.rationale: Existing components, variants, and semantic tokens reduce custom markup and preserve design-system consistency.

nodes.label: CLI Dry-Run Workflow
nodes.rationale: Dry-run, diff, and view resolve project-specific paths, CSS changes, and local diffs before files are written or overwritten.

nodes.label: Preset Switching Modes
nodes.rationale: Overwrite, merge, and skip modes preserve different amounts of local customization when changing presets.

nodes.label: Semantic CSS Token Theming
nodes.rationale: Components consume semantic Tailwind utilities mapped from CSS variables, so token changes update all dependent components and dark-mode values centrally.

nodes.label: Component Customization Order
nodes.rationale: Prefer built-in variants, then layout classes, added variants, and wrapper components to preserve component semantics and reuse.

nodes.label: MCP Project Configuration Boundary
nodes.rationale: MCP handles registry search, browsing, viewing, and installation, while CLI info remains required for aliases, framework, and Tailwind configuration.

nodes.label: Immutable GitHub Registry Snapshot
nodes.rationale: Resolving refs to commit SHAs before reading registry files prevents moving-ref caches from mixing repository versions within one command.

nodes.label: Base and Radix Composition API Difference
nodes.norm_label: base and radix composition api difference

nodes.label: Base and Radix Select API Difference
nodes.norm_label: base and radix select api difference

nodes.label: Base and Radix Control Value Shapes
nodes.norm_label: base and radix control value shapes

nodes.label: MessageScroller Behavior
nodes.rationale: MessageScroller centralizes measurement, anchoring, restored position, visibility, streaming follow behavior, and jump-to-latest instead of duplicating manual scroll logic.

nodes.label: Component Structure Contracts
nodes.rationale: Items, triggers, cards, tabs, loading states, and related parts must use provided component compositions rather than custom markup to preserve behavior and consistency.

nodes.label: Accessible Overlay Composition
nodes.rationale: Dialog, Sheet, and Drawer titles remain required even when visually hidden so overlay content has an accessible name.

nodes.label: InputGroup Composition
nodes.rationale: InputGroup-specific controls and addons replace manually positioned input buttons and preserve intended layout and behavior.

nodes.label: Form State Semantics
nodes.rationale: Field data attributes style aggregate field state while control ARIA and native attributes expose invalid or disabled semantics.

nodes.label: Component-Managed Icon Sizing
nodes.rationale: shadcn components size nested icons through CSS, so per-icon sizing classes are normally redundant and inconsistent.

nodes.label: Semantic Component Styling
nodes.rationale: Semantic tokens and variants preserve light-dark behavior and component intent, while className should primarily control layout.

nodes.label: Composition over Configuration
nodes.rationale: Explicit composition avoids exponential boolean-prop states and hidden conditional rendering while allowing shared internals.

nodes.label: Provider State Boundary
nodes.rationale: State lifted into a provider can serve visually separate siblings through one context contract without prop drilling, effects, or state-reading refs.

nodes.label: Core Composition Principles
nodes.rationale: Composition over configuration, lifted state, context-backed internals, and explicit variants keep React component APIs scalable.

nodes.label: Avoid Boolean Prop Proliferation
nodes.rationale: Each behavioral boolean doubles possible component states and produces unmaintainable conditional logic; composition makes variants explicit.

nodes.label: Use Compound Components
nodes.rationale: Shared context lets subcomponents access state without prop drilling while consumers explicitly compose required pieces.

nodes.label: Prefer Children over Render Props
nodes.rationale: Children make static structure readable and naturally composable; render props remain appropriate when parents must pass data back.

nodes.label: Create Explicit Component Variants
nodes.rationale: Named variants document providers, UI pieces, and actions directly and eliminate impossible boolean-prop combinations.

nodes.label: Generic Context Interfaces for Dependency Injection
nodes.rationale: A state-actions-meta contract lets multiple providers inject different state implementations into the same composed UI.
nodes.norm_label: generic context interfaces for dependency injection

nodes.label: Decouple State Management from UI
nodes.rationale: Provider-only state knowledge lets UI depend on a stable context interface and permits state implementation swaps without UI changes.

nodes.label: Lift State into Provider Components
nodes.rationale: Provider scope lets visually separate siblings share state and actions without prop drilling, synchronization effects, or imperative refs.

nodes.label: React Performance Rule Categories
nodes.rationale: Rules are ordered by expected performance impact, placing waterfalls and bundle size before incremental advanced patterns.

nodes.label: Do Not Put Effect Events in Dependency Arrays
nodes.rationale: Effect Event identity changes each render, so excluding it from dependency arrays avoids repeated effects and lint errors.
nodes.norm_label: do not put effect events in dependency arrays

nodes.label: Store Event Handlers in Refs
nodes.rationale: Stable subscriptions should invoke latest callbacks without resubscribing whenever callback identity changes.

nodes.label: Initialize App Once, Not Per Mount
nodes.rationale: Component effects can rerun after remounts, so app-wide initialization needs module-level guarding or entry-module execution.
nodes.norm_label: initialize app once, not per mount

nodes.label: useEffectEvent for Stable Callback Refs
nodes.rationale: Effect Events expose latest callback values without dependency-driven reruns or stale closures.

nodes.label: Prevent Waterfall Chains in API Routes
nodes.rationale: Starting independent promises early overlaps latency and prevents avoidable API-route waterfalls.
nodes.norm_label: prevent waterfall chains in api routes

nodes.label: Check Cheap Conditions Before Async Flags
nodes.rationale: A cheap synchronous rejection should run before remote work so impossible branches incur no async cost.
nodes.norm_label: check cheap conditions before async flags

nodes.label: Defer Await Until Needed
nodes.rationale: Await only in branches that consume the result so skipped paths do not block.

nodes.label: Dependency-Based Parallelization
nodes.rationale: Partial dependency graphs should start every task at its earliest valid time instead of imposing batch barriers.

nodes.label: Promise.all for Independent Operations
nodes.rationale: Independent async work should run concurrently to replace multiple sequential round trips with one latency window.

nodes.label: Strategic Suspense Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Suspense streams delayed regions while rendering surrounding UI sooner, trading faster paint against possible layout shift.

nodes.label: Prefer Statically Analyzable Paths
nodes.rationale: Literal or explicit path maps keep bundling and file tracing narrow, predictable, and memory-efficient.

nodes.label: Avoid Barrel File Imports
nodes.rationale: Direct or optimized package imports avoid evaluating large re-export graphs that tree shaking may not remove.

nodes.label: Conditional Module Loading
nodes.rationale: Feature-gated dynamic imports keep unused large modules out of active client and server bundles.

nodes.label: Defer Non-Critical Third-Party Libraries
nodes.rationale: Non-critical analytics and logging can load after hydration because they need not block interaction.

nodes.label: Dynamic Imports for Heavy Components
nodes.rationale: Lazy-loading heavy components reduces initial bundle cost and improves TTI and LCP.

nodes.label: Preload Based on User Intent
nodes.rationale: Preload heavy bundles on hover, focus, or enabled feature flags to reduce perceived latency; guard browser-only imports to avoid adding them to SSR bundles.

nodes.label: Deduplicate Global Event Listeners
nodes.rationale: Share one global listener across component instances with useSWRSubscription and a module-level callback registry.

nodes.label: Version and Minimize localStorage Data
nodes.rationale: Version storage keys, retain only required fields, and catch storage failures to support schema evolution, reduce size, and avoid sensitive-data persistence.

nodes.label: Use Passive Event Listeners for Scrolling Performance
nodes.rationale: Mark touch and wheel listeners passive when they never call preventDefault so browsers can scroll without waiting for handlers.
nodes.norm_label: use passive event listeners for scrolling performance

nodes.label: Use SWR for Automatic Deduplication
nodes.rationale: Use SWR caching, revalidation, and shared request keys to deduplicate data fetching across component instances.

nodes.label: Avoid Layout Thrashing
nodes.rationale: Batch DOM reads and writes, preferably using CSS classes, to avoid forced synchronous reflows.

nodes.label: Cache Repeated Function Calls
nodes.rationale: Cache deterministic function results in a module-level Map to avoid repeated computation across renders and non-React call sites.

nodes.label: Cache Property Access in Loops
nodes.rationale: Hoist repeated object-property and array-length lookups out of hot loops to reduce lookup work.

nodes.label: Cache Storage API Calls
nodes.rationale: Cache synchronous localStorage, sessionStorage, and cookie reads in memory while invalidating on external changes.

nodes.label: Combine Multiple Array Iterations
nodes.rationale: Combine independent array filters or maps into one loop to reduce traversal count.

nodes.label: Early Return from Functions
nodes.rationale: Return as soon as a result is determined to skip unnecessary processing.

nodes.label: Use flatMap to Map and Filter in One Pass
nodes.rationale: Use flatMap for conditional transforms to eliminate intermediate arrays and a second traversal.
nodes.norm_label: use flatmap to map and filter in one pass

nodes.label: Hoist RegExp Creation
nodes.rationale: Hoist constant regular expressions or memoize dynamic ones to avoid recreation while accounting for mutable lastIndex on global expressions.

nodes.label: Build Index Maps for Repeated Lookups
nodes.rationale: Build a Map once to replace repeated linear find operations with constant-time keyed lookups.
nodes.norm_label: build index maps for repeated lookups

nodes.label: Early Length Check for Array Comparisons
nodes.rationale: Check array lengths before sorting or deep comparison, then use immutable sorting and early mismatch returns.
nodes.norm_label: early length check for array comparisons

nodes.label: Use Loop for Min/Max Instead of Sort
nodes.rationale: Find extrema in one linear pass instead of sorting, avoiding copies and large-array spread limits.
nodes.norm_label: use loop for min/max instead of sort

nodes.label: Defer Non-Critical Work with requestIdleCallback
nodes.rationale: Schedule non-critical work during browser idle periods, with timeouts, chunking, and fallback where appropriate, to preserve interaction responsiveness.

nodes.label: Use Set/Map for O(1) Lookups
nodes.rationale: Convert arrays to Set or Map when membership or keyed lookup repeats.

nodes.label: Use toSorted() Instead of sort() for Immutability
nodes.rationale: Use toSorted or a copied-array fallback so sorting does not mutate React props or state.
nodes.norm_label: use tosorted() instead of sort() for immutability

nodes.label: Use Activity Component for Show/Hide
nodes.rationale: Use React Activity to hide frequently toggled expensive components while preserving DOM and state.

nodes.label: Animate SVG Wrapper Instead of SVG Element
nodes.rationale: Animate a wrapper div rather than an SVG element so browsers can use hardware acceleration.
nodes.norm_label: animate svg wrapper instead of svg element

nodes.label: Use Explicit Conditional Rendering
nodes.rationale: Use an explicit ternary when numeric or other renderable falsy conditions could leak 0 or NaN into JSX.

nodes.label: How We Made the Vercel Dashboard Twice as Fast
nodes.norm_label: how we made the vercel dashboard twice as fast

nodes.label: CSS content-visibility for Long Lists
nodes.rationale: Apply content-visibility auto with intrinsic sizing to skip off-screen layout and paint, improving initial rendering for long lists.

nodes.label: Hoist Static JSX Elements
nodes.rationale: Move static JSX outside component bodies to avoid recreating elements; React Compiler makes manual hoisting unnecessary when enabled.

nodes.label: Prevent Hydration Mismatch Without Flickering
nodes.rationale: Synchronously update DOM from client-only storage before React hydration so SSR stays safe and default-state flicker is avoided.

nodes.label: Suppress Expected Hydration Mismatches
nodes.rationale: Use suppressHydrationWarning only for intentional server/client value differences, never to conceal real hydration bugs.

nodes.label: Use React DOM Resource Hints
nodes.rationale: Issue React DOM resource hints early so DNS, connections, critical assets, and modules load before normal discovery.

nodes.label: Use defer or async on Script Tags
nodes.rationale: Make scripts non-render-blocking: defer ordered DOM-dependent scripts, async independent scripts, and prefer next/script strategies in Next.js.
nodes.norm_label: use defer or async on script tags

nodes.label: Optimize SVG Precision
nodes.rationale: Reduce SVG coordinate precision, optionally with SVGO, to shrink files while retaining suitable visual accuracy.

nodes.label: Use useTransition Over Manual Loading States
nodes.rationale: Replace manual loading flags for transition work with useTransition pending state to reduce state management and preserve responsiveness.
nodes.norm_label: use usetransition over manual loading states

nodes.label: Defer State Reads to Usage Point
nodes.rationale: Read dynamic browser state inside callbacks when only callbacks need it, avoiding broad reactive subscriptions and rerenders.
nodes.norm_label: defer state reads to usage point

nodes.label: Narrow Effect Dependencies
nodes.rationale: Depend on primitive or derived values rather than whole objects so effects rerun only for relevant changes.

nodes.label: Calculate Derived State During Rendering
nodes.rationale: Compute values from current props or state during render rather than mirroring them through state and effects, preventing redundant renders and drift.

nodes.label: You Might Not Need an Effect
nodes.norm_label: you might not need an effect

nodes.label: Subscribe to Derived State
nodes.rationale: Subscribe directly to coarse derived state such as a media-query boolean instead of continuous source values to reduce rerenders.

nodes.label: Use Functional setState Updates
nodes.rationale: Use functional state updates when next state depends on current state to avoid stale closures and keep callbacks stable.

nodes.label: Use Lazy State Initialization
nodes.rationale: Pass expensive initial-state computation as a function so useState runs it only during initialization, not every render.

nodes.label: Extract Default Non-primitive Parameter Value from Memoized Component to Constant
nodes.rationale: Hoist non-primitive default props to stable constants so strict identity checks do not defeat component memoization.
nodes.norm_label: extract default non-primitive parameter value from memoized component to constant

nodes.label: Extract to Memoized Components
nodes.rationale: Move expensive work into memoized child components so parent early returns can skip computation; React Compiler can remove need for manual memoization.

nodes.label: Put Interaction Logic in Event Handlers
nodes.rationale: Run action-specific side effects in event handlers rather than modeling actions as state plus effects, avoiding duplicate or unrelated reruns.
nodes.norm_label: put interaction logic in event handlers

nodes.label: Don't Define Components Inside Components
nodes.rationale: Define component types outside parent render scope and pass props, preserving component identity, DOM, effects, and local state across parent renders.

nodes.label: Do not wrap a simple expression with a primitive result type in useMemo
nodes.rationale: Compute cheap primitive expressions directly because useMemo invocation and dependency comparison can cost more than the expression.
nodes.norm_label: do not wrap a simple expression with a primitive result type in usememo

nodes.label: Split Combined Hook Computations
nodes.rationale: Split independent hook work by dependency set so unrelated changes do not recompute every task; React Compiler may optimize some cases.

nodes.label: Use Transitions for Non-Urgent Updates
nodes.rationale: Mark frequent non-urgent updates with startTransition so urgent interaction work remains responsive.

nodes.label: Use useDeferredValue for Expensive Derived Renders
nodes.rationale: Defer expensive render inputs and memoize derived computation so urgent input updates remain responsive while results lag safely.
nodes.norm_label: use usedeferredvalue for expensive derived renders

nodes.label: useRef for Transient Values
nodes.rationale: Ref mutation avoids renders for frequent DOM-adjacent updates.

nodes.label: after() Non-Blocking Work
nodes.rationale: Post-response side effects should not delay responses.

nodes.label: Authenticated Server Actions
nodes.rationale: Server Actions are public endpoints and require action-local authentication and authorization.

nodes.label: Cross-Request LRU Cache
nodes.rationale: Bounded LRU caches reuse data across requests sharing a process.

nodes.label: React.cache Request Deduplication
nodes.rationale: Non-fetch async work benefits from per-request deduplication.

nodes.label: RSC Reference Deduplication
nodes.rationale: Shared references serialize once; derived copies usually belong client-side.

nodes.label: Hoisted Static I/O
nodes.rationale: Module initialization avoids repeated static I/O.

nodes.label: No Shared Request State
nodes.rationale: Concurrent server renders make mutable module request state unsafe.

nodes.label: Parallel Component Fetching
nodes.rationale: Sibling components avoid parent-child waterfalls.

nodes.label: Parallel Nested Fetching
nodes.rationale: Per-item chains prevent slow siblings blocking ready nested work.

nodes.label: Minimize RSC Serialization
nodes.rationale: Passing used fields only reduces RSC payload.

nodes.label: Path B Release Gate
nodes.rationale: Quality and integration gate artifact creation; workflow never deploys and holds no provider credentials.

nodes.label: Operational Truth
nodes.rationale: Quantities, status, history, and cost basis must remain explicit and auditable.

nodes.label: Payment Trigger Deferral
nodes.rationale: Immutable positive payments lack correction path until linked reversal or credit-note semantics exist.

nodes.label: Blocked Path G
nodes.rationale: Source builds fail through esbuild EACCES and pnpm PATH behavior; prebuilt ZIP remains supported.

nodes.label: Durable Write Rollback Boundary
nodes.rationale: Older database restore after durable business writes would discard ledger data.

nodes.label: Official Tooling Only
nodes.rationale: Official setup paths prevent unsupported substitutes and keep production Hostinger-only.

nodes.label: Ordered auth expansion and financial inventory contract
nodes.norm_label: ordered auth expansion and financial inventory contract

nodes.label: Ops pack and Path B artifact model
nodes.norm_label: ops pack and path b artifact model

nodes.norm_label: hostinger path z manual zip deployment
